attributes.diagnostic_refutation: savedregs --raw --per-web first pairs T+0x7c `li r16,0` with O+0x368 `li r16,0` as in place, although they initialize different mode loops. It consequently pairs O+0x7c `li r22,0` with T+0xd8 `li r0,0` as INTRUDER, 23 aligned rows apart. Actual same-role counter is T+0x7c `li r16,0` / O+0x7c `li r22,0`; T+0x1b0 `addi r16,r16,1` / O+0x1b0 `addi r22,r22,1`; T+0x1b4 `cmpwi r16,74` / O+0x1b4 `cmpwi r22,74`; both +0x1c0 branch back to +0x8c. Both counters are callee-saved. T+0xd8 `li r0,0` feeds +0xe4 `slwi r4,r0,3`, the separate zero-x call argument. The entire manually inspected [+0x7c,+0x1c4) interval is bound to target SHA256 97087ce6a41ac18a47fca948e4e6935b1650f2d3691a7680c3587a40f263d2e1 and raw d90f5e21e4ca7ed1db10d74c3bf0d774fe26f22e2a4c1616ae81dcef61d94e4c. Tests reject every intervening-word mutation on both sides. This is a fixed reviewed witness, NOT a general CFG/def-use verifier. Refutation is limited to WR's inherited promotion explanation, not its rule guards or measured declaration boundaries; no global verdict on savedregs correctness is claimed.

attributes.probed_form: Executable literal forms are in source_forms() of tools/gdl/composed_census/r70_dbgtext_lifetimes.py; --forms all is baseline plus 31 finite candidates. i_per_mode declares s32 i3/i2/i5/i4 in the corresponding mode blocks and replaces that mode's i uses; i_mode3/2/5/4 do only that mode. quad_per_mode similarly declares void* quad3/quad2/quad4; scale_per_mode declares u32 scale3/scale2/scale4; j_per_mode declares s32 j3/j2/j1/j4; i_quad_joint combines i and quad forms. mode3_row_counter declares s32 rowIndex and changes only the DBGROW3 first row loop, not the trailer loop. quad_per_allocation replaces `quad = MBNewTempQuad();` with block-local `void* quad = MBNewTempQuad();`. Pointer forms split `u32* tblA = lbl_802C45CC; char* fmts = lbl_80116450; DbgRow* tblB = lbl_80127DE8;` into uninitialized declarations plus the same tblA/fmts/tblB assignment order, then separately put fmts first or last in declarations. signed_divisor/scale/shift replace only `u32 div;`, `u32 scale;`, `u32 shift = 10;` with s32; their runtime values are nonnegative and unsigned numerators preserve the intended arithmetic. divisor_unsigned_int uses unsigned int div; cursors_int uses int qline/line; locals_int changes renderer LOCAL s32 tokens and casts to int while keeping its s32 signature. Initializer controls separately/all change `extern s32 dbgTextActive/Color/Line;` to extern int, or Color to unsigned int; ownership controls define those same real scalars as s32 or int (scratch only). fn_800C031C bind_typed_cell uses existing DbgGraphCell* and `cell->acc = cell->unk8 = cell->unk4 = cell->unk0 = 0;`; bind_distinct_counter changes only second loop to separately declared s32 fixedIndex; bind_signed_arg1 changes u32 arg1 to s32; bind_int_counter changes s32 i to int.
